The idea behind the play

The web should
make you feel.

Not every interaction needs a reason. Sometimes, a little curiosity is enough.

Kinetic is an independent collection of experiments in movement, feedback, and the space between a click and a smile. Everything here is made to be touched, tested, and tried again.

Can I play on my phone?+

Absolutely. Swipe through the collection, drag the sculpture with a finger, and tap any experiment to open it. Every interaction works with touch and keyboard, too.

Prefer a little less motion?+

Use the motion switch below to pause ambient animation. Your device’s reduced-motion preference is respected automatically. All controls stay available.
